Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. You may play up to 7 play cost's total worth of [NSp] trait Digimon cards among them without paying the costs. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
[End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] 2 of your Digimon may DNA digivolve into an [NSp] trait Digimon card in the hand.
